issue: The R2 fix is incomplete. The singleton `update_<type>` and `upsert_<type>` resolvers still wrap decode errors in a bare `async_graphql::ServerError::new(msg, None)`. The same legacy encoded-string rejection therefore still carries no `extensions.code` on the singleton mutations, while the generic mutations now return VALIDATION_ERROR. Use `to_graphql_error(DoogatError::Validation(msg))` at both sites.

The set/unset collision message gets a doubled prefix. `fields_and_unsets` does `.map_err(|e| e.to_string())`, so the string already starts with "validation: ". The resolver then re-wraps it in `DoogatError::Validation`, and `error_rendering` strips the prefix only once.

FFI has no way to send a null for a field value. `FieldValue` has only Str, Num, Bool and List, and the driver wraps every entry in `Some`. Update null intent works only through `unset_fields`; on create, a caller omits the key.
Large integers are silently coerced to f64 and lose precision above 2^53, on both REST and GraphQL. The PRD's coercion risk says to "fail clearly at the boundary".
Task 6 fixes error mapping but adds no regression asserting `extensions.code`. Existing message-only tests would pass if the fix were reverted.
